title: Security Attestation & Tenant Onboarding Checklist — KMS/SAML/RBAC Operator Playbook
creator: Nina Alvarez
description: Purpose: Define a reproducible acceptance checklist and operator runbook for tenant onboarding that satisfies SSO/SAML federation, RBAC provisioning, audit logging, and customer-managed KMS/HSM expectations. This ticket scopes the product requirements, detailed acceptance criteria, evidence artifacts for audits, and the operator procedures required to sign an onboarding to 'compliant' status. It does not include implementation tasks for underlying infra drivers (separate ENG tickets).
acceptance_criteria: SSO/SAML: Tenant can successfully federate via SAML 2.0 with metadata exchange and automated metadata refresh; test saml assertion flows for login, logout, and attribute mapping.
RBAC: Tenant admin can create roles and assign least-privilege permissions mapped to Product API routes; role binding changes produce audit events with requestor identity and timestamp.
KMS/HSM: Customer-managed key import or external KMS integration accepted; HSM-backed key operations (sign/encrypt/decrypt) validated end-to-end in staging with key rotation test.

Audit logs: All authentication, authorization, key-management, and operator actions are emitted to tenant audit stream and retained per compliance policy for 365 days; sample log queries return expected events.

Evidence package: A zip containing SAML metadata screenshots, RBAC role mappings, sample audit log exports (redacted), KMS integration runbook, and HSM quorum test logs is produced and stored in the compliance bucket.
Operator runbook: A step-by-step onboarding checklist (preflight, federation, KMS handshake, smoke tests, escalation) exists and is validated via a dry-run onboarding with a test tenant.
Signoffs: Security, Legal, and Ops each provide explicit approval comments recorded in the ticket with linked artifacts before tenant is marked compliant.
Rollback: There is a documented rollback path for SAML metadata failure, KMS handshake failure, and RBAC misconfiguration with <30m mitigation steps documented.
signoff_checklist: Security review completed: threat model updated; gap items addressed or deferred with compensating controls.
Legal review: contractual language for customer key custody and audit evidence approved.
Ops readiness: operator has runbook, playbook, and test tenant onboarding completed successfully.
Product acceptance: product owner validated UI flows for tenant admin onboarding and role mapping UX.
Evidence package uploaded to GCS/Confluence with checksum and retention policy note.
Monitoring: dashboards for per-tenant SAML errors, KMS errors, and audit log delivery failures added to console.
Automated tests: end-to-end integration tests for SAML, RBAC and KMS included in CI and green for two consecutive runs.
Customer-facing docs: onboarding guide and security FAQ published and linked in the tenant portal.
qa_checks: Run the SAML federation smoke test harness against three IdP providers and record assertion attributes.
Validate RBAC enforcement by exercising every permission in the nominal permission matrix using an isolated test tenant.
Inject KMS error (permission denied) and verify graceful failure mode and alerting.
Replay audit log export and ensure redaction rules applied for PII before packaging.
Simulate operator key rotation and validate no downtime for active sessions using KV cache health checks.
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Documentation & dry-run — operator conducts two dry-run onboardings for internal test tenants.
Phase 1: Pilot customers — enable feature for 3 pilot customers with weekly check-ins and dedicated support channel.
Phase 2: Gradual ramp — open to self-serve for new private tenants with soft limits and automated preflight checks.
Phase 3: GA — remove soft limits, enable monitoring SLOs and SLA measurement; ship compliance badge in console.

decision_log: SAML metadata refresh cadence: 24 hours by default, with on-demand manual refresh option for operators.
Customer keys: support both 'bring-your-own-KMS' (external KMS) and 'managed-customer-key' (Redwood HSM-backed) models.
Audit retention: default 365 days for private tenants; configurable per contract up to 7 years as a paid option.
open_questions: Do we require automated IdP metadata signing verification for all customers or only enterprise tier? (Security leaning to enterprise-only initially).
What is the escalation SLA for an HSM quorum failure for pilot customers? (Ops to propose).
Is proof-of-possession evidence for imported keys required for all contracts or negotiable per customer?
risks_mitigations: Risk: SAML attribute mapping errors could map users to elevated roles. Mitigation: require operator-approved test mapping and automated permission smoke tests before flip.
Risk: KMS connectivity failures could lead to degraded token issuance. Mitigation: implement graceful degradation to lower-throughput fallback and alerting; document in runbook.
Risk: Audit log delivery lag could break compliance window. Mitigation: add monitoring with SLOs and replay path; surface in console with per-tenant status.
